title: Lynel Gear

{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Lynel Sword Icon.png |caption= A [[Lynel Sword]] |pronunciation= |type= |game= BotW |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Lynel Gear||Series, BotW}} is a recurring set of [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Lynel Gear is a type of weaponry made and exclusively carried by [[Lynel]]s. It consists of three tiers of increasing strength and quality. The first tier is found in the possession of regular Lynels, while the stronger Mighty Lynel Gear is used by [[Blue-Maned Lynel]]s and the strongest tier, Savage Lynel Gear, is used by [[White-Maned Lynel]]s, [[Silver Lynel]]s and [[Golden Lynel]]s. In [[Master Mode]], Lynels carry Lynel Gear that is a tier below what they typically wield. As a whole, Lynel Gear is distinguished by its high strength and durability. As Lynel [[Weapon]]s are typically large and composed of heavy stone and metal, many [[Hylian]]s have difficulty using Lynel Gear as easily as a Lynel does.{{Cite|{{Big|Lynel Sword}}
This Lynel-made sword was designed with smashing in mind rather than slicing. It's on the heavy side compared to what Hylians are used to, but it's very strong.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Lynel Spear}}
The crescent-shaped spearhead of this Lynel-made weapon gives it poor balance, making it difficult to wield. Lynels, however, can swing it effectively with a single hand.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Lynel Spear}}
The weight and cutting edge of this Lynel-made spear have both been enhanced. It's immensely heavy for a Hylian, but a Lynel can cleave through rock with a single swing.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Lynel Bow}}
This massive Lynel bow sports a bowstring made from a metal so tough, mere Hylians have trouble drawing it back.|Inventory|BotW}} The [[Lynel Sword]] and its variations are sturdily built, and the most basic kinds rely on physical impact over their slicing edges for damage. Higher-tier swords, however, possess keener edges enhanced by the presence of secondary blades branching off from the primary one, and they can cut foes in two with a passing blow.{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Lynel Sword}}
This Lynel-made sword boasts more blades and more attack power. A skilled Lynel can draw this sword simply in passing and still cut a foe in two.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Savage Lynel Sword}}
A brutal sword carried by white-haired Lynels. The savage blades are strong enough to cut down any foe, no matter how strong.|Inventory|BotW}} Lynel two-handed weapons consist of large metal clubs named [[Lynel Crusher]]s.{{Cite|{{Big|Lynel Crusher}}
This two-handed weapon is favored by the Lynels. It may be more accurate to call it a lump of metal than a weapon, but if wielded by a Lynel, it can pound you into a fine dust.|Inventory|BotW}} They are used primarily through powerful downward blows, which can crush armored foes into the dust.{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Lynel Crusher}}
This Lynel-made two-handed weapon has been reinforced to increase its durability and striking power. Its overwhelming heft will crush your foe, shield and all.|Inventory|BotW}} Lower-tier Lynel Crushers are little more than lumps of metal, but higher-quality Crushers are strengthened with more deliberately fashioned metal reinforcements, which additionally increase their weight and thus the power of their downward swing.{{Cite|{{Big|Savage Lynel Crusher}}
This Lynel-made two-handed weapon is immensely heavy thanks to a rare metal from Death Mountain's peak. The power of its downward swing is in a class all its own.|Inventory|BotW}} [[Savage Lynel Crusher]]s in particular are fitted with a rare kind of metal obtained from the peak of [[Death Mountain]]. [[Lynel Spear]]s are tipped with crescent-shaped blades designed for swinging blows, but the shape of their blades make them difficult to balance. Higher-tier variants possess larger, axe-like blades, which greatly increase the weight of the weapon and consequently the force of its blows.{{Cite|{{Big|Savage Lynel Spear}}
White-haired Lynels favor this brutal spear. Its axe-like spearhead and exceptional weight give it absolute destructive power.|Inventory|BotW}} Lynels are known to be able to cleave through rocks with a single blow of these Spears. [[Lynel Bow]]s are formed entirely from metal, as are their bowstrings.{{Cite|{{Big|Lynel Bow}}
A Lynel-made bow crafted from rough metal. True to the vicious nature of Lynel weaponry. It fires a spread of multiple arrows at once. Ideal for taking down quick-moving targets.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Savage Lynel Bow}}
This Lynel bow is made from a special steel found at the peak of Death Mountain. It has tremendous stopping power and can pierce thick armor as easily as thin paper.|Inventory|BotW}} [[Savage Lynel Bow]]s, similarly to Savage Lynel Crushers, are made from a kind of steel obtained from the the peak of Death Mountain. They fire multiple [[Arrow]]s at once, making them well-suited to taking down swift foes, and they propel them with enough force to pierce conventional [[Armor]]. [[Lynel Shield]]s possess blade-like cutting edges; higher-tier shields possess more such blades than lower-tier ones.{{Cite|{{Big|Lynel Shield}}
A sturdy shield favored by Lynels for its defensive and offensive capabilities. First and foremost a shield, but the banded edges can deal slashing attacks when deflecting.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Lynel Shield}}
This Lynel-made shield has been reinforced with armor and even more blades. Stronger in both defense and offense, it can tear through basic armor when deflecting.|Inventory|BotW}} This trait allows them to deal increased damage to foes when parrying blows, although they are still intended primarily as defensive implements.{{Cite|{{Big|Savage Lynel Shield}}
This ultimate Lynel shield is used only by the white-haired Lynels. It excels at defending against even the most brutal of attacks and cutting down powerful foes when deflecting.|Inventory|BotW}} As Lynel Gear is formed out of metal, all Weapons within this archetype sink in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. They do not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], but they will attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. Finally, they can be manipulated through use of the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. ====List of Equipment==== {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; max-width:57.5em; text-align:center" |- !style="width:25%"| Item !style="width:10%"| Strength !style="width:10%"| Durability !style="width:55%"| Description |- | [[File:BotW Lynel Sword Icon.png|link=]]
